items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan. I’m very pleased to have Carol Sudhalter with me.

ctx.x: Carol was interviewed in New York City on January 14, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan. I’m very pleased to have Carol Sudhalter with me. Thanks for making the trip into town today.

items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m happy to be with Carol Sudhalter today. You are the first person that I’ve met with under these circumstances.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m happy to be with Carol Sudhalter today. You are the first person that I’ve met with under these circumstances. It would be interesting to gather some stories about how musicians are faring in these difficult times. Generally speaking, how are you doing?
I am one of the lucky ones, Monk, I mean definitely. I’m doing just fine. It’s not, you know, that different for me, and the ways in which it’s different are very positive ways.
